title: Service a manual lifejacket inflator for repacking
instruction: Prepare the manual lifejacket inflator for handoff to the repacking bench. Use the grey cup for the removed original and the red tray for service rejects. Leave all parts released at handoff.
context: A technician hands the serviced head to the person repacking the garment. A spent cartridge can leave the wearer without gas inflation even when the assembly looks installed. This bench uses only inert training pieces.
setup: Inverted dry replica of the MD3075 manual head and its MA7203 bayonet interface, orange panel and webbing, pivoting lever, mechanical window, two supply stands, grey cup and red tray. A fired original is installed. Both loose inert training cartridges have an attached adapter ring and O-ring. One metal face is solid and one has a central recess. The two assignments share the same fixed station geometry. Dimensions and reset are in WORKCELL.md.
scoring: Judge the last 1 s with hands clear. 1.0: original in grey cup, pierced spare in red tray, intact spare hanging on both bayonet lugs, lock marks aligned and window green. 0.5: pierced spare in red tray, intact spare upright on a stand, window red and original still locked or in the grey cup. Otherwise 0. Small movement within a valid handoff is allowed.
reset_notes: Start with the fired original hanging at the lock mark and the window red. Both receptacles are empty. Run intact-first and pierced-first as separate specified resets. Report each score and selected cartridge by stand.
fidelity: Dry functional replica of the MD3075/MA7203 inspection and bayonet interface. The adapter ring physically displaces probes; the central seal is inspected separately. The pierced spare with an attached ring is a deliberate inert inspection fault. Envelope dimensions and linkage travel are bench approximations. Gas, firing, leak testing, garment packing and a serviceability certification are outside the exercise.
scores: Dream-1 scored 0.0 with the intact spare at A and 0.0 with it at B (mean 0); 2,800 actions (140 s) per episode. The RGB-guided scripted demonstration scored 1.0 in both placements, 2,780 actions (139 s) each. Primary videos show the intact-at-A placement.
